_comment: Match targets for ppcmatch.py. One entry per guest function.
CONSUMED BY ppcmatch.py (changing these changes what is verified):
symbol  exact symbol to locate: 'Foo' matches the C++ mangling ?Foo@... or extern "C" Foo.
Substring matches are REJECTED; ambiguity is a hard error.
src     source file relative to matchlab/

flags   compiler flags. CANONICAL SET = -O2 -Oc. /Oc disables the divide-by-zero trap and is INVISIBLE except in functions containing a division, where it is REQUIRED (see Page_FillFromCpu 0x8808DF70: without it MSVC emits an extra 'twi 6,rB,0' before the divwu). All 85 targets pass with it. XDK LIBRARY code (e.g. D3DDevice_CreateTexture 0x88079970) is -O1, not -O2.
insn    declared instruction count -- RECONCILED against the extent ppcmatch derives from
the image; a disagreement is a hard error, not a silent truncation.
HUMAN LEDGER ONLY (never read by the tool -- do not mistake these for checks):
status  ASM-EXACT | DIFF | WIP    role, note, sha1
sha1    recorded for the human record; the real check is the byte compare, which is
strictly stronger. Do NOT treat a matching sha1 field as verification.
Verified against XDK 9328 cl.exe 15.00.8327 for PowerPC. Run --selftest after touching the tool.
